from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find block: largest solid rectangle of one non-bg color
    best=None
    for c in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg}:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
        rect=all(g[i][j]==c for i in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1) for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1))
        area=(max(rs)-min(rs)+1)*(max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
        if rect and (best is None or area>best[0]): best=(area,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    _,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v==bg or (r0<=i<=r1 and c0<=j<=c1): continue
            # stamp onto nearest edge
            dr=min(i-r0, r1-i) if c0<=j<=c1 else (min(j-c0, c1-j) if r0<=i<=r1 else 99)
            if c0<=j<=c1:
                target=(r0 if dr<=r1-i else r1, j)
            elif r0<=i<=r1:
                target=(i, c0 if dr<=c1-j else c1)
            else: target=(r0 if i<r1 else r1, c0 if j<c1 else c1)
            out[target[0]][target[1]]=v
    return out
import json
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    gi,go=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    print(k, solve(gi)==go)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
